notes.decision: Translated 'nature' (Greek φύσις). The chapter is structured around the φύσις of each sense-faculty (eyes, ears, smell) as a personified feminine entity with houses, treasuries, and chambers. The 'nature' is the inner-cosmic structure of the sensory-storage apparatus.

Translated 'shafts' for ϣⲁϩ — the third architectural element after houses (ⲏⲓ̈) and treasuries (ⲁⲡⲟⲫⲏⲕⲏ). Coptic ϣⲁϩ can mean 'pit, shaft, hollow.' Functions as the deepest layer of internal storage.
Translated 'Again the time when' — circumstantial relative construction introducing a temporal clause about the φύσις acting upon stored impressions.

Translated 'is drawn in heart.' ⲏⲕ qualitative likely from a verb of approach/inclination (cf. ⲱⲕⲙ̄/ⲱⲕⲉ family). Combined with ⲁ̄ⲧⲛ̄ⲛⲁⲩ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'to look out at' = the eye-faculty inclines/yearns inwardly toward the stored likeness.
ⲁⲥ-ⲝⲓ-ⲧϩ 'she-take/carry-it' (Lyc. ϫⲓ + 3sg.m suffix). Recurring verb of the page (segments 4, 7, 16, 20, 26) — the technical verb for the faculty's act of conveying impressions inward to storage.

Conjunctive ⲛ̄ⲥ- + ⲛ̄ⲧ + 3pl/3sg suffix + ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'forth' = 'and she brings them/it forth.' The retrieval-verb complementing ⲁⲥⲝⲓⲧϩ (storage). The pair establishes a complete carrying-in/bringing-out cycle.
ⲉⲓⲧⲉ Greek 'whether'; ⲃⲉ uncertain — possibly emphatic particle or scribal element. Translated minimally as 'whether either' to preserve the disjunctive force without speculative addition.
ϯ 'gives' + ⲛ̄ⲥ- conjunctive + ⲣⲧⲍⲉ 'do likewise' = 'gives, doing in like manner.' Iterative formula introducing the type-mapping: each sense-faculty operates on the same pattern.
Greek τύπος 'type, figure' — translated 'this type' (per glossary). The technical exegetical term for the typological correspondence between the three sense-faculties' processes.
'Ten of hundred(s) of days' = 1000 days. The temporal extent of the ear-faculty's storage period before retrieval. Numeric construction ⲙⲏⲧ (10) + ϣⲉ (hundred) + ⲍⲟⲟⲩⲉ (days).
Temporal clause 'when one comes to seek' — ⲛⲧⲉ-ⲟⲩⲉ 'when one' + ⲉⲛⲩ̄ (ⲉ-ⲛⲏⲩ 'coming') + ϣⲛ̄ (ϣⲓⲛⲉ 'seek'); verb split across line break 19/20.

ⲡⲓⲧⲱϣ 'this boundary/portion' repeated as a structural marker — first closing the previous section (ear-faculty), then opening the new one (smell-faculty). Standard chapter-internal sectioning device.

ⲙⲁⲛ- ('place of') + ϣⲱⲗⲙ ('smell') = 'the place of smelling' — the olfactory faculty named in the same compound pattern as ⲙⲁⲛⲥⲱⲧⲙⲉ 'place of hearing' in line 26. Direct correspondence with bodily organ as cosmic locus.
Compound ⲣⲉϥ- + ϣⲓⲛⲉ = 'the inquirer/asker.' Standard agentive formation paralleling ⲣⲉϩ†ⲥⲃⲱ 'teacher.' The figure who petitions the storage-faculty for retrieval of an impression.

ⲡ- + ⲣ̄- + ⲡⲙⲉⲩⲉ ('thought/memory') = 'the remembrance' or 'the act of remembering.' The retrieved impression as memory delivered to the petitioner. Built on ⲡⲙⲉⲩⲉ (per glossary, second of the five faculties = ennoia).
